subject: Owner-supplied deterministic 3+2+3 output generator
method: Executed against the real frozen registry with synthetic states constructed to expose each candidate defect. Frozen per-case states are in owner-controlled storage and were not used.
verdict: The structure is right. Four defects were reproduced, and the first destroys the single property that justifies strict-evidence mode.

D1_direct_evidence_is_truncated_alphabet.why_it_is_critical: The strict-evidence audit established explicit_expression_retention = 1.0 as the entire virtue of this design: it loses no user-stated word and removes only untraceable material. Alphabetical truncation breaks exactly that property. Two words the user explicitly said are discarded because of their spelling.
D1_direct_evidence_is_truncated_alphabet.proposed_fix: Direct evidence must never be dropped for budget reasons. Overflow beyond main_max should occupy secondary ahead of any mid-level representative. If direct evidence exceeds main plus secondary, that is a signal the budget is wrong, not that the words are unimportant.

D2_dropped_words_are_replaced_by_a_broad.code: covered_dims computed from main only, not from direct_named
D2_dropped_words_are_replaced_by_a_broad.consequence: A user-stated word cut by D1 leaves its dimension looking uncovered, so the generator emits the dimension's broad representative instead. The user says lemon, the system drops lemon and answers citrus-family.
D2_dropped_words_are_replaced_by_a_broad.proposed_fix: Compute covered_dims from the full direct_named set, independent of what fits in main.

reproduction.note: Which two of four dimensions are represented is decided by dimension name spelling.

D3_secondary_dimension_choice_is_alphabe.proposed_fix: Order uncovered dimensions by evidence strength: SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE before PROPOSED, then a declared tiebreak. Alphabetical order is a fallback that must be stated, not a default that happens.

reproduction.consequence: The only SUPPORTED dimension was pushed out by alphabetical order. Every emitted direction is merely PROPOSED. Evidence strength is inverted.

D4_profile_ignores_evidence_strength_and.proposed_fix: Rank SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE above PROPOSED and truncate within tier, never across tiers.

reproduction.user_sees: citrus-family in the named slot and fruity as a direction, which is the same information twice

D5_a_dimension_can_occupy_both_secondary.assessment: This is a product judgement rather than a bug. The secondary representative is strictly more informative than the bare direction, so suppressing the direction for a dimension already represented in secondary would reduce redundancy. But it also weakens overall_profile's role as a complete statement of supported directions.
options: Suppress the profile entry when the same dimension already has a secondary representative
Keep both and accept the duplication as intentional role separation
Keep both but mark the profile entry as already represented

what_the_structure_gets_right: main from direct evidence only, keeping the retention property intact in principle
secondary from mid-level representatives of uncovered dimensions, requiring no relation edge
all three slots deterministic with no fitted parameter
role separation preserved: broad.* are NAMED_DESCRIPTOR, attribute.* stay in profile

the_common_pattern_across_D1_D3_D4.observation: Three of the four defects are the same mistake: sorted() used as a budget cut, so lexicographic accident decides what the user sees.
the_common_pattern_across_D1_D3_D4.significance: This is the third time in this project that alphabetical ordering has silently become a decision rule. It appeared in the earlier fuzzy decision-tree prototype and in the equivalence-class tie-breaking analysis.
the_common_pattern_across_D1_D3_D4.recommended_standing_rule: Any truncation must order by a declared evidence property first. sorted() may only break ties after that, and the contract must say so.

measurement_note.cannot_run_the_owner_evaluation_yet: evaluate_secondary_metrics requires the frozen per-case states, which are in owner-controlled storage. Secondary non-empty rate and mean secondary count cannot be computed here.
measurement_note.also_blocked_by: The 6 broad.* concepts are proposed but not created, so 7 of 9 dimensions still have no representative. Running the evaluation before they exist would measure the gap, not the design.
